items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I was taking Lewis place with him and, see I had never been to the Vindu

ctx.x: Sorry. I was going to tell you about this fellow in Chicago, I just called his name, Erskine Tate. Yeah, I mentioned that. Let me tell you. I was taking Lewis place with him and, see I had never been to the Vindu, and when you take a solo, that spotlight right over your head like that, see. And so there was playing the center of his blues, and he told me, he said, now Punch, and I went, as soon as the saxophone player finishes course, you jump right up and light out. I said, okay.
